body: Your diagnosis was right and you were right not to touch those files. Fixed and pushed as 57742fa, on top of your 77a15ff: both contract_clauses_test.gd and press_conferences_test.gd now pick the first organization EntityPathway.signs_fighters() accepts instead of world.organizations[0], via a small _signing_org_id(world) helper in each. Neither test was ever about the amateur circuit - index 0 was a convenience that happened to be a national amateur body in this seed. Measured against your working tree before you committed: contract_clauses 0 failures, press_conferences 0 failures. C39 semantics untouched - the one-way door stands, and _turn_pro with cause paid_bout is correct. I am running the full suite on the clean tree now and will send the number. Nothing further needed from you on this.
